v1DefinitionOfDone.title: Universal bounded repository understanding
v1DefinitionOfDone.claimBoundary: LOCAL_VERIFIED bounded repository understanding from existing protected Universal Intelligence owners: neutral read-only discovery exposes explicit physical/semantic coverage; supported repository-local relationships carry bounded evidence and confidence; unresolved relationships remain explicit unresolved facts; unproven architecture remains unclassified with confidence unknown; sensitive-content boundaries are preserved; profiles, derived indexes, projections and semantic retrieval cannot invent authority or truth. This does not prove arbitrary-repository completeness, complete semantics for every language/stack, production, enterprise, paid-pilot, hosted, legal/privacy/security or universal semantic completeness.
evidence: bounded external diversity: 7 pinned unrelated repositories on Ubuntu and Windows with read-only/repeatability and explicit zero-edge cases recorded rather than fabricated
negativeTests: unresolved local import remains unresolved with repository-fact reason instead of invented edge
unproven architecture remains layer=unclassified / confidence=unknown / evidence=[]
sensitive-name content remains unread and unhashed
derived index, semantic retrieval and profile hints remain non-authoritative
knownBlindSpots: Bounded evidence does not prove arbitrary-repository or all-language semantic completeness.

Static repository understanding does not prove complete dynamic/runtime behavior or companion-path recall.
